spec.expr:
# Highest enemy evolution value among the selected surfaces.
max(100 * factorio_evolution_factor{surface=~"$surface",force="enemy"})

spec.description: Maximum generation minus maximum load across selected surfaces. Negative means available generation cannot meet maximum demand.
spec.title: Power headroom

spec.expr:
# Highest contribution per evolution component across the selected surfaces.
max by (component) (100 * factorio_evolution_component{force="enemy",surface=~"$surface"})

spec.title: Damage to player structures by type
Enemy kills and player structure losses

spec.description: Robots grouped by the first assigned logistic order. Includes robots waiting on that order; sampled once per minute. Requires the updated Wiretap mod and bridge.
spec.title: Logistic robot work

spec.description: Aggregated across surfaces selected by the Surface filter.
spec.title: Logistic network item stock

spec.expr:
# Research progress rate for the active technology, shown as percentage points per hour.
max(deriv(factorio_research_progress{force="player",technology=~".+"}[15m]) * 360000 and on (force, technology) factorio_research_current{force="player"})

# Shows READY when every ammo turret on the selected surfaces has ammunition. A positive value is the number of empty ammo turrets.
sum(factorio_empty_turret_count{surface=~"$surface"}) or vector(0)

# Moving, waiting, and blocked player trains across selected surfaces.
sum(factorio_train_moving_count{surface=~"$surface"})

spec.description: Damage per minute from enemy attacks that hit player-force structures, averaged over five minutes. Intercepted attacks are not included.
spec.title: Damage reaching defenses

spec.description: Five-minute rolling rates: enemy hits that reached player structures, enemy kills by the player force, and player structure losses to enemies. Hits count damage events, not attacks intercepted before impact.
spec.title: Combat activity

spec.expr:
# Science-pack consumption by type, aggregated across selected surfaces.
sum by (item) (factorio_science_pack_consumption_per_minute{surface=~"$surface"})

# Enemy spawners on selected surfaces with absorbed_pollution > 0.
sum(factorio_pollution_absorbing_nest_count{surface=~"$surface"})

spec.title: Robots working
spec.description: Robots with an assigned first work order across the selected surfaces. Includes robots waiting on that order; sampled once per minute.

spec.title: Construction robot work
spec.description: Robots grouped by the first assigned construction order. Includes robots waiting on that order; sampled once per minute. Requires the updated Wiretap mod and bridge.

spec.title: Robots waiting to charge
spec.description: Robots queued for a charging slot across the selected surfaces.

spec.name: surface
spec.label: Surface
spec.description: Select one or more planets/platforms; All shows every surface.
